text: dft-12: already landed, not new. Template v16 (653c5e5, cfd-10-landed) says in tasks/001-start.md that a replay item whose call starts the engine fails before the install and that src/replay.py runs again after it; v17 to v36 carry it. The bundle of runs dft/20261117-20 and -22 was built from text before that. Line dft-12-landed (ad042f7). dft-13: a fault of the general judge, not run_example's alone. The bundle's runner checked a contract's enum on a string only and never const, so no contract could say that a call which answers ended well, and an item naming no output field passed whatever came back. Landed in template v36 (46b9d64): src/run_tool.py checks enum and const on every type, so an output reporting an engine that ended otherwise comes back as an error; src/replay.py prints that error's message beside its code; the builder refuses an interface task or replay item that expects an output and names no field of it, or names one the contract does not declare (meta_agent/src/build/expectations.py). Shown in meta_agent/tests/test_template_v36.py on a DFT engine's example run ending with exit status 1 and an optical spectrometer's saturated reading, watched failing with v35's tree in v36's place (5 of 8). Line dft-13-landed (ad042f7). dft-14, meta side: a general gap. A maker's reference output fits both spec (from the maker) and prior_run (a run elsewhere), and the grade table gives spec no row for a computed value. v36's classify-knowledge (46b9d64), text only, names the case: its kind of value is computed, its kind of source and grade wait for the person's word, and the session does not choose one. The kind itself and the grade table in a bundle are asked of you in note 20261123-meta-office-20261123-1-1 (be8f65e), with a recommendation of prior_run. Line dft-14-landed (ad042f7).
